## Runs 6–7 — raw field scans and fan design read

Electron run 6 (nominal n=+3.2e12 cm^-2) and hole run 7 (n=-1.2e12), both provisional D=0, are complete. Raw gain-divided channels precede measured-current resistance and linear-R spectra below. Run 6 spans -33..530 ohm and 9.843..9.935 nA; run 7 spans -0.38..587 ohm and 9.809..9.931 nA. Neither approaches the 50 uV voltage range. Negative R excursions are retained, not log-clipped or silently made positive.

For 1.5–10 T, electron FFT maxima near 7.1, 14.1, 22.9, 30.0 T overlap a harmonic sequence; the hole record has maxima near 5.3 and 12.4 T. Window shifts change weaker maxima. These are evidence for resolvable oscillations, not independently identified pockets or a stacking assignment. Low-field onset estimates from the automatic helper include censored/residual and harmonic candidates; they do not justify a precise mobility or onset claim here. The run-5 two-ridge pattern is a possible inhomogeneity confound, not proof of two independently measured spatial regions. Only B_1–B_2 is wired as a voltage pair.

**Next (plan step 4):** a density–field fan at provisional D=0, including both signs and both neutrality ridges, to distinguish harmonics from independently moving branches and test whether fan slopes support the geometry-anchored absolute density scale. D=0 is inferred from resistance symmetry and remains a hypothesis. A D-dependent resistance ridge alone does not distinguish ABAB/ABCA/ABCB. The inherited numerical band predictions in measure cells 39–42 lack a documented Hamiltonian/parameter derivation in this session and will not be used as decisive model evidence.

from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from hera.analysis import open_run, resolve_channels, current_channel, sdh_fft, sdh_onset
from scipy.signal import find_peaks
root = Path(globals().get('file_path', 'data'))
fig, ax = plt.subplots(2, 3, figsize=(14, 7))
for j, rid in enumerate((6,7)):
    r = open_run(root/str(rid)); channels = resolve_channels(r.meta)
    cur = current_channel(channels); volt = next(c for c in channels if not c.is_current)
    I = r.col(cur.col)/cur.gain; V = r.col(volt.col)/volt.gain
    B = r.col('magnet_field'); order = np.argsort(B); B = B[order]; R = (V/I)[order]
    ax[j,0].plot(B, V[order]*1e6, lw=.8, label='voltage (uV)')
    ax[j,0].plot(B, I[order]*1e9, lw=.8, label='drain (nA)'); ax[j,0].legend(fontsize=8)
    ax[j,0].set_title(f'data/{rid}: raw gain-divided channels'); ax[j,0].set_xlabel('B (T)')
    ax[j,1].plot(B,R,lw=.8); ax[j,1].set(xlabel='B (T)',ylabel='signed V/I (ohm)',title='Measured-current resistance')
    print(f'run {rid}: complete={not r.interrupted}; N={r.rows}; R={R.min():.2f}..{R.max():.2f} ohm; I={I.min()*1e9:.4f}..{I.max()*1e9:.4f} nA; elapsed={(r.data[-1,0]-r.data[0,0])/60:.2f} min')
    for lo in (1.5,2.,2.5):
        f,a = sdh_fft(R[:,None],B,b_range=(lo,10),nfft=4096,bg_degree=3,log=False)
        a=a[0]; use=(f>=3)&(f<=55); ax[j,2].plot(f[use],a[use]/a[use].max(),label=f'{lo}–10 T')
        p,_=find_peaks(a); p=[k for k in p if 3<=f[k]<=55]; p=sorted(p,key=lambda k:-a[k])[:5]
        print(f'  linear-R FFT {lo}..10 T: peaks {[round(float(f[k]),2) for k in p]}, resolution {1/(1/lo-0.1):.2f} T')
    ax[j,2].set(xlabel='F (T)',ylabel='normalized FFT',title='Window robustness (cubic B background)');ax[j,2].legend(fontsize=8)
fig.tight_layout(); fig.savefig(root.parent/'hera_scratch'/'spots_6_7.png',dpi=150); plt.show()
# Median point times separate the scan floor from gate-map latency.
r=open_run(root/'5'); t=r.col('time'); dt=np.diff(t); within=np.arange(1,r.rows)%66 != 0
print('run 5: within-row median',np.median(dt[within]),'s; row-boundary median',np.median(dt[~within]),'s; dwell 1.0 s')
for rid in (6,7):
 r=open_run(root/str(rid)); dt=np.diff(r.col('time')); db=np.abs(np.diff(r.col('magnet_field')))
 print('run',rid,'median excess over bare ramp',np.median(dt-db*7.3*60),'s/point')

## HERA — Plan step 4: both-sign D≈0 Landau fan

> **05:22** · Landau fan B\_1-B\_2: provisional D=0; n=-1.2..+3.2e12 cm^-2 (177); B=0 then 2..10 T uniform 1/B (51); Si=0; base T; 3 s dwell · **ETA ~15:52** (≈10h30m)

Runs 6–7 show resolvable oscillations on B_1–B_2 with ~9.8–9.9 nA drain current and voltage peaks below 6 uV. Their strongest electron frequencies (~7 and 30 T) overlap possible harmonics, and run 5 contains two neutrality ridges; this fan tests how branches move with density before assigning stacking. The zero-field row rechecks the contact pair after the operator's state0 restoration (measure cells 44/46). Calibration is run 5's capacitance ratio and offsets; its absolute density remains geometry anchored and D=0 is a resistance-symmetry hypothesis.

Density spans −1.2..+3.2×10¹² cm⁻² in 0.025×10¹² steps, with TG −0.277033..+0.983594 V and BG −0.465040..+1.166281 V. Field starts at 0 T, then increases from 2 to 10 T uniformly in 1/B (51 rows, Δ(1/B)=0.008 T⁻¹). This gives FFT resolution ~2.5 T and Nyquist 62.5 T; the fourfold density interval at 2 T has ~7.7 points. Fine symmetry splitting and sharp high-field crossings can remain unresolved. Both carrier signs and both neutrality ridges are included; density outside this range approaches the TG fence. Below 2 T is omitted except the baseline: extending to 1 T at the same field sampling adds ~10 hours and requires finer density sampling for narrow features.

Price calculation: 9204 points × ~3.15 s (3 s = 10τ at τ=0.3 s / 24 dB; run 5 measured 0.098 s overhead above its 1 s dwell, with allowance for an extra gate and thermometer) plus gate flybacks and row checks, plus 10 T × 7.3 min/T = 73 min bare ramp. Runs 6–7 measured ~3.08 s additional overhead per field set. Including row freshness checks and 10% contingency gives the stated estimate. Ends at 10 T for a subsequent downward measurement. Sensitivity 100 uV gives 10 kohm nominal headroom; no bias, pacing, Si, heater, or limit changes.

**Checkpoints:** inspect the zero-field row against run 5 before committing farther; then the first three finite-field rows for drain continuity, leakage, clipping, phase, thermometry and flat channels. Read the armed hera-watch monitor at least every 30 min thereafter, update ETA and reform complete rows for raw maps followed by signed measured-current resistance. Stop for >1 nA gate leakage, three consecutive current-collapse/near-clipping points, stale thermometry, or field mismatch; a safety stop returns to E0 and requires re-grant. No stacking conclusion from an automatic tone count. On this VTI, kernel interrupt does **not** stop an in-flight magnet ramp: the supply continues to its last target and an immediate ramp stop is operator work.

Preconditions print expected/actual validator bounds, base temperatures and advancing logfiles, zero starting field, heaters off, PS/output on, Si at 0 V on RNGE 2, committed gate pacing, hardwired contacts, drive and lock-in settling. Every followed channel is plotted. All checks precede instrument writes.

# Plan step 4: fixed provisional D=0 Landau fan, hardwired B_1-B_2.
# Read-only preconditions precede every instrument write.
import json
from pathlib import Path
from scipy.constants import e, epsilon_0

def fan_require(label, actual, expected, ok):
    print(f'{label}: expected {expected}; actual {actual}')
    assert ok, f'PRECONDITION FAIL: {label}'

for p, bounds in [(k_tg.volt,(-0.3,1.0)),(k_bg.volt,(-1.3,2.0)),
                  (dc205.smart_voltage,(-25.,25.)),(dc205.voltage,(-25.,25.)),
                  (magnet.field,(-10.,10.)),(heater.sample_setpoint,(0.,100.)),
                  (heater.vaporizer_setpoint,(0.,100.))]:
    actual=(float(p.vals._min_value),float(p.vals._max_value))
    fan_require(p.full_name+' validator',actual,bounds,actual==bounds)
fan_require('session caps',(B_SESSION_CAP,T_SESSION_CAP),(10,100),B_SESSION_CAP==10 and T_SESSION_CAP==100)
fan_require('gate aliases',(k_tg.name,k_bg.name,k_si.full_name),'card aliases',
            k_tg is k_2400_tg and k_bg is k_2400_bg and k_si is dc205.smart_voltage)
for key in ('T_sample','T_vaporizer'):
    assert_thermometry_live(key,VTI.temp_logfile_candidates[key],max_age=15,max_period=12)
_ts,_tv,_b=T_sample(),T_vaporizer(),magnet.field()
fan_require('sample T',_ts,'1.0..1.5 K',1.0<=_ts<=1.5)
fan_require('vaporizer T',_tv,'<1.6 K and within 0.6 K of sample',0<_tv<1.6 and abs(_tv-_ts)<0.6)
fan_require('initial field',_b,'0 T +/-0.02 T',abs(_b)<0.02)
_hr=(heater.sample_range(),heater.vaporizer_range())
fan_require('heater ranges',_hr,(0,0),_hr==(0,0))
_ms=(magnet.persistent_switch_on(),magnet.output_enabled())
fan_require('magnet PS/output',_ms,(True,True),all(_ms))
_si=(dc205.voltage_range(),dc205.output(),k_si(),dc205.ramp_rate)
fan_require('Si range/output/V/rate',_si,'2 / 1 / 0 V / 0.5 V/s',_si[:2]==(2,1) and abs(_si[2])<0.01 and _si[3]==0.5)
_pacing=(k_tg.volt.step,k_bg.volt.step)
fan_require('Keithley steps',_pacing,(0.005,0.005),_pacing==(0.005,0.005))
_nplc=(k_tg.nplci(),k_bg.nplci())
fan_require('gate NPLC',_nplc,(1,1),_nplc==(1,1))
_w={'source':'T_0','drain':'B_3','sr1+':'B_1','sr1-':'B_2',
    'sr2+':'n.c.','sr2-':'n.c.','sr3+':'n.c.','sr3-':'n.c.'}
fan_require('hardwired contacts',WIRING,_w,WIRING==_w and 'mux' not in globals())
_drive=(sr1.amplitude(),sr1.frequency()); _tau=(sr0.time_constant(),sr1.time_constant())
_slopes=(sr0.filter_slope(),sr1.filter_slope())
fan_require('drive V/Hz',_drive,(1.,13.777),abs(_drive[0]-1.)<1e-6 and abs(_drive[1]-13.777)<0.001)
fan_require('lock-in tau/slope',(_tau,_slopes),'0.3 s / 24 dB both',_tau==(0.3,0.3) and _slopes==(24,24))
_s0=sr0.sensitivity(); fan_require('current sensitivity',_s0,0.02,_s0==0.02)
print('actual starting TG/BG:',k_tg.volt(),k_bg.volt(),'; both will be set to first fan point')

# Explicit SI inversion of GateCalibration; density labels remain geometry anchored.
FAN_CAL=json.loads((Path(main_dir)/'hera_scratch'/'cal_run5.json').read_text())
assert FAN_CAL['run']==5
fan_n=np.linspace(-1.2,3.2,177) # 1e12 cm^-2
fan_D=0.0 # V/nm
fan_tg=(e*(fan_n-FAN_CAL['n_offset'])*1e16+2*epsilon_0*(fan_D-FAN_CAL['D_offset'])*1e9)/(2*FAN_CAL['c_tg'])
fan_bg=(e*(fan_n-FAN_CAL['n_offset'])*1e16-2*epsilon_0*(fan_D-FAN_CAL['D_offset'])*1e9)/(2*FAN_CAL['c_bg'])
fan_B=np.r_[0.,field_invB(2.,10.,51)]
_fcal=GateCalibration(FAN_CAL['c_tg'],FAN_CAL['c_bg'],FAN_CAL['n_offset']*1e16,FAN_CAL['D_offset']*1e9)
assert np.allclose(_fcal.density(fan_tg,fan_bg)*1e-16,fan_n)
assert np.max(abs(_fcal.displacement_field(fan_tg,fan_bg)))<1.
for p,vs in ((k_tg.volt,fan_tg),(k_bg.volt,fan_bg),(magnet.field,fan_B)):
    for v in vs: p.validate(float(v))
print('planned TG/BG endpoints:',fan_tg[[0,-1]],fan_bg[[0,-1]],'B rows',len(fan_B),'density points',len(fan_n))

# No change to pacing, validators, bias, heater, or Si.
sr1.sensitivity(100e-6) # 10 kohm nominal FS; run 5 max 2.9 kohm
mc=dict(meas_config)
mc.update({'sr1_gain':1.,'Si (V)':_si[2],'sample_temperature:':_ts,
 'calibration':FAN_CAL,'nominal_n_1e12_cm2':fan_n.tolist(),'nominal_D_V_nm':fan_D,
 'lockin_tau_s':list(_tau),'lockin_slope_dB':list(_slopes),
 'comments':'landau-fan: provisional D=0; n=-1.2..3.2e12, 177 pts; B=0 then 2..10 T uniform 1/B, 51 pts; Si=0; base T; calibration run5'})
s=sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('landau-fan')
s.add_comment('plan4; B_1-B_2; n=-1.2..+3.2e12 cm^-2, step0.025e12; D=0 provisional; TG=-0.277033..0.983594 V; BG=-0.465040..1.166281 V; B=0 plus 2..10 T uniform 1/B (51); Si=0 V; dwell3s; sr1=100uV; absolute density geometry anchored')
followed=[T_sample,T_vaporizer,k_tg.curr,k_bg.curr,sr0.X,sr0.P,sr1.X,sr1.P]
for p in followed:
    s.fp(p)
    s.plot('time',p)
# Grid columns [time,B,TG,BG,*followed], raw X retained (gains applied in analysis).
_fan_state={'points':0,'bad_signal':0,'reason':None}
_fan_nf=len(fan_n)
def fan_before(station):
    if _fan_state['points']%_fan_nf==0:
        for key in ('T_sample','T_vaporizer'):
            assert_thermometry_live(key,VTI.temp_logfile_candidates[key],max_age=15,max_period=12)
        actual=magnet.field(); expected=fan_B[_fan_state['points']//_fan_nf]
        print(f'ROW precondition measured B={actual:+.5f} T, expected {expected:+.5f} T')
        if abs(actual-expected)>0.03:
            _fan_state['reason']='field readback mismatch'
            station.interrupt_requested=True

def fan_after(station,data):
    vals=dict(zip([p.full_name for p in followed],map(float,data[4:])))
    ts,tv=vals[T_sample.full_name],vals[T_vaporizer.full_name]
    ig=max(abs(vals[k_tg.curr.full_name]),abs(vals[k_bg.curr.full_name]))
    ix=vals[sr0.X.full_name]/mc['sr0_gain']; vx=vals[sr1.X.full_name]
    bad=(not np.isfinite(ix+vx)) or not (8e-9<ix<12e-9) or abs(vx)>0.9*100e-6
    _fan_state['bad_signal']=_fan_state['bad_signal']+1 if bad else 0
    reason=None
    if not np.all(np.isfinite(data)): reason='nonfinite data'
    elif ig>1e-9: reason='gate leakage >1 nA'
    elif not (1.0<=ts<=1.5 and 0<tv<1.6 and abs(ts-tv)<0.6): reason='temperature outside base envelope'
    elif _fan_state['bad_signal']>=3: reason='three consecutive clipped/current-collapse points'
    _fan_state['points']+=1
    if reason:
        _fan_state['reason']=reason
        print('FAN STOP:',reason,'B/TG/BG',data[1:4],'I',ix,'V',vx,'leak',ig)
        station.interrupt_requested=True
    if _fan_state['points']%_fan_nf==0:
        print('ROW COMPLETE',_fan_state['points']//_fan_nf,'/',len(fan_B),'B',data[1],flush=True)
s.register_run_before(fan_before,())
s.register_run_after(fan_after,())
s.ramp(k_bg.volt,float(fan_bg[0])); s.ramp(k_tg.volt,float(fan_tg[0]))
interruptible_sleep(10)
fan_result=s.multimegasweep([magnet.field],[fan_B],[k_tg.volt,k_bg.volt],[fan_tg,fan_bg],slow_delay=3.,fast_delay=3.)
print('FAN COMPLETE: readbacks B/TG/BG/Si/Ts/Tv',magnet.field(),k_tg.volt(),k_bg.volt(),k_si(),T_sample(),T_vaporizer())
# Hold the endpoint for an informed down-field follow-up; no automatic retraverse.
